notes.title: Update v1.3!
notes.content:
Hello again, today we are adding a new window on the menu that players might find interesting!

General

 Added the "Extras" button in the main menu, allowing players to check out Behind The Scenes info, and the game's credits!.

notes.title: Patch v1.2
notes.content:
The patch v1.2 is here, with multiple bug fixes, and new functions in the menu.

General


 A new "Chapters" widget was added to select a specific chapter to play.
 The settings menus have been improved significantly.

notes.title: Bloody Hills Demo Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281386/0ed7f1d43755478c9e75cf3e4a4e504eaf2d7b1e.png
This version of the game is what the final release will look like and how it will look gameplay-wise. 

We've changed a lot since the last demo, let's start with the updated visuals.

As we mentioned before, we've updated the games visuals to look more natural and a bit brighter at night, this also includes changes to the flashlight light and the lights around the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281386/5f129d579e645e88e976658463ca4dd5e2a02756.jpg

We have added brand new keybind settings and we little bit revisited exisiting keys and decided to change the interaction button from "E" to the left mouse button, which also sometimes helps you speed up the game a bit and open some doors faster in the chase.

General bug fixes and small additionals.

- We reworked the first 2 chapters a bit and added some new props / lore.

- Improved chapter 1 cinematics.

- Added AI animals to make forest feel more alive and real.

- Tuned down some sounds that were too loud by default.

- Fixed Foliage Scalability setting.

- Removed First Aid and fall damage.
  (We came to the conclusion that fall damage was worthless and almost never used in the game, and it was also a bit buggy, which also leads to the removal of first aid and anything related to health in other chapters).

- Fixed several spots in Chapter 2 where The Hikers gets stuck while in chase.

- Fixed collisions and optimized game.

We hope you enjoy this small update and try updated demo before the full version. If you find any bugs, please report them on our Discord server or Steam Forums. Stay tuned for the September 20th release!

notes.title: Visuals Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281386/4be49a809da4fd205719bf9a5f18e1689f14af06.png

We heard your feedback from the Bloody Hills Demo and decided to rework every map lighting and visuals to make them more colorful and bright. Check out some images with updated visuals, including images of new Chapters that will be included in the full version and upcoming Teasers, such as "Camp Sunny Hills" and "The Mine". We hope this change will make player experience better and bring more new players. We are looking forward for release this year, Stay tuned!
